excerpt: Sift easily integrates into your existing systems using modern REST APIs, Javascript snippet, and SDKs for iOS and Android.

What actions your users are taking, usually key user lifecycle events (e.g., creating an account, placing an order, posting content to other users, etc.). You will send this data from your application to Sift via our REST API.

What actions your business is taking in response to users (e.g., approve an order, block and event due to fraud, cancel order due to chargeback, etc). You will also send this data from your application to Sift via our Decisions API.
Because Sift gets smarter the more data it has about your business, you can jump start your integration by backfilling a few months worth of historical data.

Sift Science founder: 'We were lucky to find some early beta customers like Airbnb, Uber, and Listia, who were all looking for what we were building and willing to take a risk with a startup.'

Founder explains fraud detection approach: 'If a fraudster bypasses the JS, we still have REST events such as transactions... Seeing a user who has REST events but no Javascript events is a suspicious signal in itself.'
Potential customer notes hesitation: reservations about sending personal user data to an aggregator that would then require legal review for privacy law/security certification compliance.

Sift Science founder on false positives: 'Most of our customers review each user we flag, and have a human make a final go/no-go decision about whether to accept the transaction. I'd recommend starting with that configuration.'
User review: 'I use sift science, in addition to some basic fraud prevention, and what they are doing has allowed me to sleep easier at night. Kudos to the Sift Science team!'
Early user feedback: 'I have been integrating it for a day or so. The documentation is slightly confusing and they've had a few minor bugs in their UI, but support has been really good thus far.'
Competitor comparison: 'I run a product in this space... and I'm quite impressed with Sift Science's pricing. No charge for the first 10k transactions/month is impressive.'
CEO explains no-rules ML approach: 'we do not have any rules in our product... rules are rather easy for fraudsters to circumvent, and they require merchants to play whack-a-mole.'
Skeptic comment questioning the 'no rules just data' approach, comparing to Falcon Fraud Manager which uses both rules and ML, doubting a purely data-centric approach makes sense.

Critical take: 'The biggest problem with ML is that it takes time for it to react to new fraud patterns/schemes. While rules engines have limitations, they allow to block recognized fraud really fast.'
